paragraphs: Under Narion’s cover, Saerenn leads the companions out of the ambush. They press on through the forest, but soon hear branches snapping behind them. The orcs have picked up their trail.

Faelina pauses and holds out her hand. Out of her sleeve crawls the little white spider we’ve seen before. It spins webs along the trail. Faelina has long been friends with spiders. On each web she leaves three venomous spiders and links them with a silk thread. The red-marked spider can smell orc blood, the blue-marked one recognizes goblin footsteps, and the one with the pale round spot knows the stench of trolls.

With the traps in place, Faelina catches up with the others and they press on. When a creature passes beneath a web, a signal runs along the silk to the first spider. If it recognizes its prey, it stops the signal, lowers itself on a thread, delivers a venomous bite, and climbs back up. Otherwise, it passes the signal to the next spider. If all three let the signal pass, the traveller walks on unharmed.

When the orcs come down the trail, the red-marked spiders catch the scent of orc blood. They drop from their webs, and the pursuers fall one by one. By the time the forest falls quiet again, the companions are already far ahead.
